title: NVDLA BDMA Source-Memory Switch RTL Repair
taskName: NVDLA BDMA Source-Memory Switch RTL Repair
summary: Diagnose and repair a command-pipeline defect that prevents NVDLA BDMA batches from completing when consecutive commands switch source memory.
taskPrompt: Repair the staged NVDLA BDMA RTL so batches of consecutive commands complete correctly when the source memory changes between MC and CVSRAM. Work only in the writable vmod/nvdla/bdma source directory, build with the native NVDLA tmake flow inside the prepared task container, and preserve ordinary same-source command pipelining.
agentMustDo: Read the staged task brief and inspect the writable BDMA RTL source.
Reproduce the public mixed-source command-chain hang with the native NVDLA Verilator target and a bounded per-run timeout.
Repair the defect only in vmod/nvdla/bdma RTL source files.
Run relevant public and regression traces and record the diagnosis in JOURNAL.md.

inputFiles.name: task_instructions.md
inputFiles.description: Task scope, native build commands, public symptom, and submission requirements.

inputFiles.name: public_tests
inputFiles.description: One passing same-source command chain and one mixed-source chain that fails to complete.

referenceFiles.name: BDMA RTL source
referenceFiles.description: Submitted writable BDMA RTL overlaid on a clean NVDLA seed during evaluation.

referenceFiles.name: JOURNAL.md
referenceFiles.description: Concise diagnosis, edit summary, and tests run.

evaluation: The evaluator discards the agent's task container, overlays the submitted BDMA RTL directory on a clean pinned NVDLA seed, performs a clean Verilator rebuild, and runs deterministic command chains with independent per-case timeouts. A successful clean build is required but earns no standalone credit. Same-source command-pipeline regression behavior contributes 5%, and MC/CVSRAM source-switch behavior contributes 95%.
